Photo 1: Front view of the same phone showing the home screen with a wallpaper of a man in a hat and sunglasses. The time '7:30' and date 'Thu 22 Oct' are visible. The screen has smudges and a visible crack near the bottom right corner.
Photo 2: Back view of the phone showing a triple-camera module in a square bump, with a matte grey or space grey finish. The phone has rounded edges and a flat back.
All photos have a watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI JAS PER'.
